Fix: Resolve TypeScript error in CourseForm

The commit addresses a TypeScript error in `CourseForm.tsx` where a string was being assigned to a `string[]` type for the `skills` field. The fix involves updating the Zod schema to transform the comma-separated skills string into a `string[]` array using a `transform` function, ensuring the correct data type is used.

Fix: Resolve type error and restrict Courses menu

- Fixed a TypeScript error in `CourseForm.tsx` related to the `skills` field.
- Modified `AppSidebar.tsx` to show the "Courses" menu item only to users with the "administrator" role.

Fix: Add "Courses" menu and "Add Course" button

- Added "Courses" menu item to the sidebar, visible to admins.
- Added "Add Course" button to the Courses page.

Fix: Course skills should be an array

The skills field in the course form was incorrectly handling comma-separated strings. This commit updates the code to correctly handle an array of skills.

Fix: CourseForm skills type mismatch

The `skills` field in `CourseForm.tsx` was incorrectly assigning a string to a `string[]` type. This commit fixes the type mismatch by ensuring the `skills` field in the form uses a `string[]` type, resolving the TypeScript error.

Run SQL for course management

Applies the SQL to create the courses table and RLS policies.

commit.message:
Uncomment RLS policies in migration

Uncomment the RLS policies in the migration file to execute them during a migration.

Refactor: Store RLS policies in migrations

Store Row Level Security (RLS) policies from Supabase in a new migration file.

Fix: Current plan marker not updating

The current plan marker was not updating correctly when switching between monthly and yearly billing cycles. This commit ensures the correct plan is marked as active in `PlanSelector.tsx`, `PlanSettings.tsx`, and `supabase/functions/check-subscription/subscription.ts` by correctly identifying the active plan based on the selected billing cycle.

Fix: Correct Stripe price ID mappings

Corrects the mapping of Stripe price IDs in `src/config/stripe.ts` to align with the intended Standard and Premium plans, resolving inconsistencies in plan identification and display.

Fix: Plan selection cycle issue

The PlanSelector component was incorrectly marking the current plan as active when switching between monthly and yearly billing cycles. This commit ensures that the correct plan is highlighted based on the selected cycle and the current plan's price ID.

Fix: Incorrect plan marking in PlanSelector

The PlanSelector component was incorrectly identifying the current plan due to a mismatch between the plan ID and the Stripe price IDs used for comparison. This commit updates the logic to correctly identify the active plan by comparing against the correct Stripe price IDs.

Fix: Resolve STRIPE_CONFIG undefined error

The `STRIPE_CONFIG` variable was not being correctly imported into `src/components/billing/PlanSelector.tsx`, causing a runtime error. This commit imports `STRIPE_CONFIG` from `src/config/stripe.ts` to resolve the issue.

Fix: Plan page price display

The Plan page was displaying the incorrect price for the Premium plan. This commit fixes the issue by ensuring the correct price is displayed, based on the Stripe configuration.

Fix: Display price discrepancy

The PlanSettings page was displaying the correct prices, while the BillingSettings page was not. This commit ensures that the BillingSettings page displays the correct prices.

Refactor: Align plan cycle detection

Update PlanSettings.tsx to use the same approach as BillingSettings.tsx for determining the billing cycle, using price IDs from stripe.ts for consistency.

Revert price display changes

Reverts the changes made to the price display logic, as the price IDs are configured in `stripe.ts`. This includes reverting changes to `BillingSettings.tsx`, `src/utils/pricing.ts`, and related logic.

Fix: Check logs for billing page

The AI was asked to check the logs for the billing page.

Refactor: Improve BillingHistory and BillingInvoices

- Refactored BillingHistory and BillingInvoices components for consistency.
- Removed BillingHistory and replaced it with BillingInvoices.
- Improved error handling and loading states.
- Added mobile support for invoice display.
- Updated the display of the billing history.

Fix: Inconsistent price display in /plan and /billing

The pricing display was inconsistent between the /plan and /billing pages. This commit addresses the issue by ensuring the correct billing cycle (monthly or yearly) is used to display the price and interval consistently across the application.

Fix: Correctly display billing cycle in /billing

The /billing page was incorrectly displaying the monthly price for the standard plan, even when the user was on an annual plan. This commit ensures the correct billing cycle is used when displaying the price in the BillingSettings component. It also ensures the correct cycle is passed to the PlanCard component.

Remove admin page and related logic

Removes the /app/admin route, AdminHome component, and associated logic from the codebase. This includes removing the route definition in App.tsx, the AdminHome component file, and any related imports or references. Also removes the `initialize-stripe-products` and `initialize-stripe-portal` functions from the Supabase config.

feat: Sidebar header layout and logo visibility

-   Placed the logo and collapse/expand button in the SidebarHeader on a single line.
-   Hid the logo completely when the sidebar is collapsed.

Fix: Improve tooltip styling

Refactor tooltip styles to use a traditional design with primary blue alignment for info, errors, and warnings.
Reverted to commit 1d8972689edd0cf49bcdab3a3ffdadc601ba8dbb

Fix: Verify Stripe portal configuration

The AI verified the Stripe portal configuration, ensuring the settings are applied correctly in the Stripe dashboard. It also added detailed logging for debugging.

feat: Implement default portal configuration

- Set default values for "Allow cancel subscriptions" and "Allow manage subscriptions" to "No".
- Prevent users from modifying these settings in the UI.
- Display these settings in the /app/admin/ page.
- Use these default values in the relevant logic.
- Add detailed logging to verify Stripe portal updates.

Fix: Resolve sidebar import error

The commit fixes a TypeScript error in `src/components/ui/sidebar/sidebar-components.tsx` by correcting the import of `useIsMobile`. The hook was declared locally in `sidebar-context.tsx` but not exported, leading to the error. The fix ensures the correct hook is imported.

feat: Refactor Stripe configuration into a module

- Moved Stripe product and price initialization, and customer portal configuration logic into a separate module.
- Modified customer portal configuration to allow updates for Name, Address, and Tax ID only.
- Removed Terms of Service and Privacy Policy settings from the UI and logic.
- Activated the customer portal during initialization.
- Updated `AdminHome.tsx`, `initialize-stripe-portal` and `initialize-stripe-products` functions.
Reverted to commit 06fe8b95755d0e81b743fc1cd64c321629f3f8e4

Fix: Resolve runtime error in TooltipProvider

The error "Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useState')" is caused by an issue with the TooltipProvider component. This commit addresses the error.

Fix: Save portal config as admin config

The customer portal configuration should be saved as an admin configuration, not a session configuration.

Fix: Ensure portal initialization updates UI

The Stripe portal initialization function was successfully creating a configuration, but the UI wasn't reflecting the changes. This commit addresses the issue by ensuring the UI is updated after a successful initialization.

Fix: Customer portal parameter handling

The AI is checking if the correct parameters are being sent to Stripe when opening the customer portal.

Refactor: Isolate product and price logic

Isolate product and price initialization logic into separate functions.

Add function to configure customer portal

Add a new function to configure the customer portal.

Check function logs

The user requested to check the logs.

Fix: Customer portal not updating

The AI addressed the issue of the customer portal not updating. It improved error handling and logging in the `initialize-stripe-portal` and `customer-portal` edge functions. The `AdminHome` component was updated to display initialization results and error messages.

Fix: Check for errors in portal initialization

The AI checked for errors in the `initialize-stripe-portal` function and found an error when attempting to store the Stripe secret key. The AI also confirmed that the portal configuration still completes successfully.

Remove Stripe key input and add instructions

Remove the Stripe Secret Key input field from the AdminHome interface. Display instructions on where to set the key in Supabase instead.

Fix: Activate customer portal before initializing

The AI ensured the customer portal is activated before initialization and addressed the issue of changes not being applied.

Fix: Override STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in edge functions

The commit allows the user to override the `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` in the `initialize-stripe-products` edge function by passing it in the request body. This is done to allow the user to enter the key in the UI.

feat: Add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY field

Adds a field for the STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in the admin page.

feat: Implement admin page for Stripe configuration

- Adds a hidden admin page accessible only to administrators.
- Allows specifying STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and previews plan configuration.
- Implements functionality to initialize Stripe products and prices.
- Includes an option to initialize the customer portal with specific settings.

Fix: Increase sidebar width

Increase the width of the left menu by 24px to prevent icon and collapse/expand button cut-off in the collapsed state.
Reverted to commit 1ec0df0f65dc002c1f14fa54504949fbaa3a379a

Fix: Sidebar icons cut off in collapsed state

Adjust sidebar styling to prevent icon clipping in the collapsed state.

Fix: Align logo and toggle button

Adjusted the padding of the small logo in `AppSidebar.tsx` to align it with the "Home" link and horizontally with the collapse/expand toggle button in desktop view.

feat: Align logo and menu toggle on desktop

- Place the small logo and the menu toggle button in the same line on desktop.
- Hide the logo when the sidebar is collapsed.
- Preserve the existing collapse/expand functionality and positioning.

Fix: Reduce spacing on mobile app pages

Apply top padding to all /app pages to reduce the gap between the UserProfileMenu and the content on mobile devices.

Refactor: Adjust spacing for mobile menu alignment

Adjusted spacing in `UserProfileMenu.tsx` to improve alignment with the mobile menu hamburger icon.

Fix: Double top padding

Increase the top padding of the UserProfileMenu component.

Fix: Restore top padding

Reverted the removal of top padding in UserProfileMenu, as it was not intended.

Refactor UserProfileMenu layout

Remove padding from UserProfileMenu in AppLayout.

Refactor: User profile menu layout

Move user profile menu to a separate row and align to the right with padding.

Fix: Enforce subscription check on login

- Modify AuthContext.tsx to reset rate limiting and check subscription after SIGNED_IN event.
- Modify Auth.tsx to reset rate limiting after successful login.

Refactor: Skip admin email, add all users as users

- Removed admin email functionality from the migration script.
- Ensures all new users are added with the 'user' role.
